name: web-admin-instruction-field
goal: Admins enter the instruction when creating a task type and edit it later in vendor-web.
design_constraints: The instruction textarea stays editable when runtimeLocked is true.
Required non-blank on create and on edit save; 500-char limit with counter.
Labels, placeholders and errors live in questiontemplate constants.ts; no hardcoded UI strings.

repository_conventions.copy: Feature constants + ADMIN_VI dictionary keyed by English text via useAdminCopy
repository_conventions.tests: vitest node env, renderToStaticMarkup with @pte/ui and adminCopy mocked

boundaries.api-client: types only; vendor-web is the only consumer of task-type request types

applicable_rules: no hardcoded UI strings; no magic numbers (TASK_TYPE_INSTRUCTION_MAX_LENGTH)
